not_generated.why: the reference target has no manned intake; in a systems run the ANSP adapter polls a sim-adsb the load harness does not serve, so the USSP shows manned traffic unavailable (its degraded state, in the report)

not_generated.source: authority DP polls of the USSPs (05 §1: one view per 1 Hz), against the reference target

disabled by default (02 F6) and not in the reference target
